intent: Implement PipelineConfiguration exactly as tabled. Single wiring factory (@Configuration with @EnableConfigurationProperties(the TelemetryProperties instance method class)) and the ONLY registration mechanism: every bean below is a factory @Bean method, no unit self-registers. The @SpringBootApplication composition root already lives in the base package com.pulsestream.telemetry (scaffold, no second boot class); component scanning of the base package covers this class. Providers: StepLog, ValidationService, ReorderingService, AuditTrail (R2dbcAuditTrail), EventLogRepository (R2dbcEventLogRepository), EventBroadcast (SinkEventBroadcast), EventLogService, IntakeService, CorrelationWebFilter (installs the contextWrite correlation filter), TelemetryIngestController. telemetryPipeline provides the lifecycle-managed Disposable (destroyMethod dispose) that subscribes: stream() of the intake service -> map via validate() -> buffer by Duration.ofSeconds(reorderWindowSeconds) -> map via reorderWindow() -> flatMapIterable -> concatMap via append(); this is the consumer of every rule service. The out-of-process consumer of the EventBroadcast instance method stream() is declared in the strategy.

methods.signature: ValidationService validationService(TelemetryProperties properties, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
ReorderingService reorderingService(TelemetryProperties properties, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
EventLogService eventLogService(EventLogRepository repository, EventBroadcast broadcast, AuditTrail auditTrail, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
IntakeService intakeService(TelemetryProperties properties, AuditTrail auditTrail, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
Disposable telemetryPipeline(TelemetryProperties properties, IntakeService intakeService, ValidationService validationService, ReorderingService reorderingService, EventLogService eventLogService)
